method: Scripted playthrough using the game’s real hotspot callbacks and crossing gates. Walking between scenes and long crossing cameras are skipped through the public debug capture API. The sun is advanced to puzzle hours; actor placement uses encounter fixtures, while stillness and regard run in the live game. No progression flags or puzzle answers are granted. The opening, first return, final return, boat launch, persistence and all four endings are checked. This is a route audit with screenshots, not a recording of an uninterrupted manual play session.
